title: House No. 6 At Lane 50 Ward Road Occupied By Russian

page_data.en:
FM 2
G. 55/1-38

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
Misc. File No. 132/38.
REPORT
Wayaide Station,
Date July 30, 1938.
Subject...House No.6 at Lane 50 Ward Road occupied by Russian lawyer
I.V. Mousy-Moussienko without permission of the lawful tenant.
Made by. T.S. Suhoff. Forwarded by.

Sir,
At 10 a.m. 29.7.38, one Sultan Ali, British Indian,
employee of Hal-Ald and residing at Lane 572, House 84 Boone
Road, came to this station accompanied by Mrs. Gulbaz, also
British Indian, and made the following report:-
For the past 5 years Mrs. Gulbaz and her husband were
residing at Lane 50 House No.6 Ward Road, which premises they
rented from a Chinese landlord for $40.00 per month.
On August 14th, 1937, owing to the Sino-Japanese hostiliti-
es Mr. and Mrs. Gulbaz evacuated from their residence and re-
moved to French Concession. In September same year Mr. Gulbaz
died, and Mrs. Gulbaz being unable to visit her former resid-
ence herself, requested Sultan Ali to do so.
Sultan Ali stated that he visited the house frequently
and on May 27th, 1938, he having obtained certificate from
H.B.M. Consulate and a Japanese "pass" removed the majority
of furniture left in the house to the South of Creek area,
after which he secured the windows and nailed the doors from
outside. The landlord of this house, a Chinese, was formerly
residing on Broadway but since the Sino-Japanese hostilities
he could not be located and none of the house tenants in Lane
50 Ward Road know his present whereabouts.
On 30.5.38, Sultan Ali became sick and until 9.7.38 was
detained in Paulun Hospital. On 29.7.38, he came to Ward Road
and found House 6 Lane 50 occupied by Russians, whereupon he
came to this station. The present occupier of the house in
question I.V. Mousy-Moussienko was called to this station
when enquiries ascertained the following:-

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
杂项档案第 132/38 号。
报告
外白渡桥巡捕房，
日期：1938年7月30日。
事由……华德路50弄6号房屋被俄国律师
I.V. Mousy-Moussienko 在未经合法租户许可的情况下占用。
具报人：T.S. Suhoff。转呈人：

先生，
1938年7月29日上午10时，一名英籍印度人 Sultan Ali，
系 Hal-Ald 公司雇员，居住于布恩路（Boone Road）572弄84号，
偕同亦为英籍印度人的 Gulbaz 夫人来到本巡捕房，并作如下报告：—
过去五年间，Gulbaz 夫人及其丈夫一直居住在
华德路50弄6号，该处房产系他们以每月40.00美元的租金
从一位中国房东处租得。
1937年8月14日，由于中日战事，Gulbaz 夫妇
撤离住所，搬至法租界。同年9月，Gulbaz 先生
去世，Gulbaz 夫人因无法亲自前往其原住所，便委托 Sultan Ali 代为处理。
Sultan Ali 称，他经常去该房屋查看，
并于1938年5月27日，在取得英国驻华领事馆的证明及日本当局签发的“通行证”后，
将留在屋内的大部分家具搬至苏州河以南地区，
随后他将窗户封好，并从外面将门钉死。该房屋的中国房东原先居住在百老汇路（Broadway），但自中日战事爆发以来，
已无法找到其下落，华德路50弄的房屋租户中无人知晓其目前行踪。
1938年5月30日，Sultan Ali 生病，直至1938年7月9日一直
住在宝隆医院（Paulun Hospital）。1938年7月29日，他来到华德路，
发现华德路50弄6号已被俄国人占用，遂前来本巡捕房报案。
涉案房屋的现居住者 I.V. Mousy-Moussienko 被传唤至本巡捕房，
经询问查明以下情况：—

Residing previously in French Concession in May 1938,
Moussy-Moussienko decided to remove to the North of Creek area
and visited this district, with an object of renting a house.
He made enquiries amongst the Russian residents in Lane 50
Ward Road and found that House No.6 was vacant and not secured.
He stated that he was informed by some Russians that the pre-
vious tenants had removed the furniture and had no intention
to return to this house and he, Moussy-Moussienko, decided to
occupy the house from June 2nd, 1938.
On the same date, he came to this station and reported
the removal to officer on charge room duty .... 220 Tchereka-
shansky. The entry in the Occurrence Book made by the above
officer on June 2nd, 1938, reads:-
"Resident in the District: Mr. I.V. Moussy-Moussienko,
Russian Emigrant, reports that he is going to reside at House
No.6, Lane 50 Ward Road, from 2.6.38".
Mrs. Gulbaz and Sultan Ali stated that they did not
inform any Russian in Lane 50 that they were leaving the house,
but in the contrary intended to sublet the rooms as they felt
responsible for the premises before the landlord who might
appear and demand the house rent, which they would be obliged
to pay.
I.V. Moussy-Moussienko stated that he was willing to pay
the rent commencing from June 1st, 1938, and if the old tenants
wished to re-occupy the house he would move out immediately.
Mrs. Gulbaz agreed to let to Moussy-Moussienko 2 rooms
from June 1st, 1938, for $25.00 and demanded the rent for 2
months due to her ($50.00).
The latter had no money at present but promised a

Moussy-Moussienko 此前于1938年5月居住在法租界，
决定搬至苏州河以北地区，并为此来到本区看房租房。
他在华德路50弄的俄国居民中进行打听，发现6号房屋空置且未加封锁。
他称，有俄国人告知他，前租户已搬走家具，并无意返回该房屋，
因此他，Moussy-Moussienko，决定自1938年6月2日起占用该房屋。
同日，他来到本巡捕房，向值班警官 ...... 220号 Tchereka-
shansky 报告了搬迁事宜。上述警官于1938年6月2日在《事故记录簿》中的记载如下：—
“区内居民：俄国流亡者 I.V. Moussy-Moussienko 先生报告称，
他将于1938年6月2日起居住于华德路50弄6号”。
Gulbaz 夫人和 Sultan Ali 称，他们并未通知华德路50弄的任何俄国人
他们将离开该房屋，相反，他们打算转租房间，因为他们觉得
对可能现身并要求支付房租的房东负有责任，而他们是必须支付这笔租金的。
I.V. Moussy-Moussienko 表示，他愿意支付自1938年6月1日起的租金，
如果旧租户希望重新入住该房屋，他将立即搬出。
Gulbaz 夫人同意自1938年6月1日起以25.00美元的价格
将两间房间出租给 Moussy-Moussienko，并要求支付
欠她的两个月租金（50.00美元）。
后者目前无钱支付，但承诺提供

at 14 Museum Road, Room 41A, 3rd floor. Both parties left the
station to proceed to the above offices to have a necessary
agreement made, promising to inform the undersigned of the

However up to the moment the results of negotiations
